name: list_clients
description: List client ids in an advisor's book. Always call this first when given only an advisor_id.

name: get_signals
description: Derived signals, relationship context and prior advisor outcomes for one client. Every value returned is citable evidence.

name: assess_savings
description: Whether FHSA + HBP-eligible RRSP + liquid savings cover a down payment, and months to target.

name: check_qualification
description: Rule-based mortgage qualification (GDS/TDS at the stress-test rate). Deterministic; do not override its result.

name: record_outcome
description: Advisor-gated write. Records what the advisor did with a card. Only call when the user explicitly asks to record an outcome.
